availabilityRule.rule: Before canonical classification, availability is an existence preflight over eligible re-diagnosed candidates using the full diagnostic and immutable registry; it does not recursively call get_fallback_candidates whose precondition is DEGRADED. After classification, canonical selection requires DEGRADED. Execution policy authorization occurs after planning and never turns a valid mapping into a different bit value.

idReservation: IDs shown are synthetic examples; adopting entries requires reserving globally unique identifiers or replacing them in an immutable adopted supplement.
purpose: Proposed negative test input only: immutable available registry with no eligible candidates.
